Good to know

Questions, answered.

Are estimates really free?

Yes — we come out, look at the actual job, and give you a written price. No fee, no obligation, no pressure.

Are you licensed and insured?

Fully — licensing, liability, and workers' comp. We're happy to provide certificates before work begins; any contractor who hesitates on that is telling you something.

Do you offer financing?

On larger jobs, yes — simple approved financing so an urgent repair doesn't have to wait on a paycheck.

What if something isn't right after the job?

Call us and we make it right — our workmanship guarantee is in writing. Standing behind the work is the whole reputation.
